title: O Where Are the Reapers?
lyrics: Verse 1:
[D]O [G]where are the reapers that [C]garner [G]in
The [D]sheaves of the good from the [G]fields [C]of [G]sin?
With sickles of truth must the [C]work be done,
And [G]no one may rest [C]till the [D7]harvest [G]home.”
Verse 2:
[D]Where are the reapers? O [G]who [D]will [G]come
And [D7]share in the glory [G]of the [D]harvest home”?
O [G]who will help us to [C]garner in
The [G]sheaves of good [C]from the [G]fields [D7]of [G]sin?
Verse 3:
The fields all are ripening, and far and wide
The world now is waiting the harvest tide
But reapers are few, and the work is great,
And much will be lost should the harvest wait.
Verse 4:
So come with your sickles, ye sons of men,
And gather together the golden grain;
Toil on till the Lord of the harvest come,
Then share ye His joy in the "harvest home."
